news.headline: Technical picks:  ABB India among 5 stocks to buy this week for healthy returns
news.summary: The recent market activity indicates a bullish trend, albeit with minor profit booking influencing trading patterns. Investors are keenly observing macroeconomic factors and international cues. Selected stocks like GVT&D, ABB, Bank of Baroda, NCC, and Mankind Pharma have emerged as likely candidates for profitable investments, as technical analysts highlight their positive trends and robust bullish signals for future growth.

news.headline: US stocks: Nasdaq slides over 1% as AI selloff deepens ahead of Nvidia earnings
news.summary: US stocks fell as investors reacted to a selloff in AI firms, with Nvidia taking a hit. The resignation of Jensen Huang, Nvidia's leader, raised concerns, adding to market anxiety. Simultaneously, fresh US regulations limited China's access to advanced AI chips, further affecting sentiment. Major semiconductor companies reported notable losses, weakening overall market confidence. Investors now look to the Fed's insights and upcoming earnings for future guidance.

news.headline: Sebi sets up sub-group under PMAC to review key IPO norms; NSE's Chauhan to head panel
news.summary: Sebi has established a sub-group within its Primary Market Advisory Committee aimed at reassessing regulations related to IPOs and fundraising. The initiative seeks to streamline compliance requirements to foster easier access to capital markets. Key focal points include promoter capital lock-in terms, pricing strategies, and due diligence obligations. The group will evaluate relevant Sebi circulars for potential modifications, with final recommendations to be presented to the PMAC for review.

news.headline: PNB among 4 stocks hitting 52-week highs; stock rallies up to 24% in a month
news.summary: Four BSE 100 stocks, including PNB, Eternal, Federal Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank, touched fresh 52-week highs. Here's how much these stocks have gained over the past month.

news.headline: India bonds dip as elevated inflation fuels rate hike expectations
news.summary: Indian government bonds have taken a hit, driven by increased selling pressures and fears of imminent interest rate hikes. The benchmark bond yield climbed slightly, mirroring movements in US Treasuries. In light of fresh inflation data, expectations have intensified for rate increases in both the US and India, leading analysts to modify their inflation outlook for an upcoming RBI meeting.

news.headline: Sebi may propose raising FPI beneficial ownership threshold to 25%; plans consultation paper
news.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) is contemplating raising the beneficial ownership stake for foreign portfolio investors from 10 percent to 25 percent. This proposed change aims to simplify compliance and bring India in line with global standards. A consultation paper will be released shortly to collect input from stakeholders on easing regulations.

news.headline: Sebi forms panel to simplify capital-raising rules
news.summary: India's markets regulator has established a 10-member panel to review regulations concerning capital raising by companies. The panel, chaired by Ashish Chauhan of NSE, includes executives from various financial institutions. It will assess eligibility criteria, lock-in periods, and rules for securities allocation and allotment. Furthermore, the group will examine disclosure requirements for initial public offerings and follow-on offers. This initiative aims to simplify regulations and enhance access to capital markets.

news.headline: India's investments in US Treasuries jump USD 38.4 bn in Jun-Aug amid FCNR flows
news.summary: India's investment in US Treasury securities increased by USD 38.4 billion due to FCNR(B) deposits during three months. The Reserve Bank of India introduced a special facility to encourage these foreign currency deposits. This facility led to significant inflows, improving India's foreign exchange reserves substantially. Experts suggest that investment in US Treasuries may slow down due to the closure of the FCNR(B) window. India's reserves grew to USD 740.

news.headline: US stocks: Summit shares drop after US FDA declines to approve lung cancer drug
news.summary: Summit Therapeutics faced a notable decline in share value following the FDA's ruling on ivonescimab, which revealed insufficient overall survival benefits during late-stage trials. Despite Summit's emphasis on regional survival differences, analysts worry that this decision could have repercussions for similar treatments in development. Investors now eagerly await new trial results comparing ivonescimab with conventional lung cancer therapies.

news.headline: Blackstone REIT to buy majority stake in $5 billion Amazon data center portfolio
news.summary: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust has officially announced its commitment to acquire a 75.1% stake in joint ventures alongside Amazon Web Services. This significant deal values the AWS data center portfolio at around $5 billion, marking a bold entry into the market. The portfolio features 13 newly constructed powered shells with long-term leases back to AWS.

news.headline: Rupee rises, volatility ebbs as equity inflows blunt global headwinds
news.summary: The Indian rupee demonstrated notable strength by closing 0.3% higher at 93.9225 against the dollar. November saw foreign equity inflows amounting to nearly $10 billion, reversing recent trends of outflows. Analysts highlighted that these inflows contributed to the rupee's stabilization amid expectations of potential US interest rate hikes. The Nifty 50 index also climbed by 0.6%, buoyed by limited exposure to AI trades.

news.headline: Swiggy among 10 midcap stocks that dropped up to 50% in CY26
news.summary: The Nifty Midcap 150 has gained around 2% in CY26, but several constituents have suffered steep corrections. Swiggy, PI Industries and Rail Vikas Nigam lead the 10 biggest laggards, with losses ranging from 32% to 52%.

news.headline: Barclays lowers 2027 year-end target for S&P 500 index to 8,700
news.summary: On Monday, Barclays revised its S&P 500 index target for the 2027 year-end from 8,800 to 8,700. The adjustment reflects concerns regarding higher interest rates impacting financial conditions. Analysts believe that tighter financial conditions may lead to increased valuation dips. Strategies suggested by Barclays indicate limited potential for valuation expansion moving forward. Analysts emphasize careful monitoring of the evolving financial landscape in the coming years.
